descriptions.w3d_cc17c_object_register_801e74d0: Registers an object in the global object table: reuses the first null slot or appends it, stores the slot number in the object's 10-bit index field at +32, notifies 0x801ffea8 and, when the global flag 0x804ab894 is set, returns the result of 0x801e7e24 for it.
